scope: A fictional MCP server exposes a read-only search tool over a synthetic document collection. No external network access or write-capable tools are enabled.

findings.finding: The fictional helper should use a dedicated read-only identity instead of a general workspace identity.
findings.mitigation: Use a dedicated least-privilege identity limited to the synthetic collection and document a revocation path.

findings.finding: Retrieved fictional content could contain instructions that attempt to influence tool selection.
findings.mitigation: Treat retrieved text as untrusted content, enforce an allowlist of read-only tools, and require confirmation before any future high-impact action.

findings.finding: The fictional prototype needs an event record for tool name, actor, parameter summary, allow/deny decision, and result category.
findings.mitigation: Add privacy-aware audit logging and define retention/access rules before using non-synthetic data.
